QuestInfo.name: Even If We Might Not Meet Again
QuestInfo.0:
Gaia has revived the Eternal Forest. Everything has returned to normal except for two empty spots: Gaia and the Great Tree. 

You still feel the warmth of her final embrace, and waves of grief threatened to bring you to your knees. 

And all just when you thought you could finally reunite with her...
QuestInfo.1:
Gaia said she'll always be with you in spirit.
You believe her. You won't cry.
QuestInfo.2:
Gaia...
Someday, when fate allows it, you will meet again.
